steps.title: Switch the machine off at the strip
steps.instruction: Turn off the power strip switch.
steps.visual_check: the power strip switch light is off and the lamp is off

steps.title: Unplug and lock the plug
steps.instruction: Unplug the machine and close the plug inside the red lockout box.
steps.visual_check: the machine's plug is inside the red lockout box and the box is closed

steps.title: Hang the tag
steps.instruction: Attach the yellow DO NOT OPERATE tag to the lockout box.
steps.visual_check: a yellow tag is attached to the red lockout box

steps.title: Verify zero energy
steps.instruction: Press the machine's own switch. It must stay off.
steps.visual_check: a hand presses the lamp's own switch and the lamp stays off
steps.common_mistake: Opening the cover without testing the switch

steps.title: Remove the cover
steps.instruction: Remove the 4 cover screws onto the tray and lift the cover off.
steps.visual_check: the box cover is off and the screws are on the tray

steps.title: Swap the filter
steps.instruction: Take the old filter out and put the new one in.
steps.visual_check: the new filter's color is visible inside the open box

steps.title: Refit the cover
steps.instruction: Put the cover back on and refit all 4 screws.
steps.visual_check: the cover is on the box and the screw tray is empty

steps.title: Remove lock and restore power
steps.instruction: Remove the tag and lock, plug in, switch on.
steps.visual_check: the lockout box is empty and the lamp is on
